```{r}
library(targets)
library(plotly)
```

# The intervention sites and their control matches

The following maps demonstrate the location of the intervention sites
across England and then, for each one individually, show where the
current set of control sites are.

Currently, the controls are matched according to whether they are part
of a sub-set of specialty providers e.g. cancer or cardiothoracic and
then having a similar % of single-bed inpatient rooms prior to the
switch.

The next iteration of this matching of control sites will include
factors on hospital size and patient case-mix to improve the suitability
of comparisons fed into the Causal Impact Analysis.

```{r overview_map}
tar_read(map_all)
```

\

# The trends for each impact measure

For all the indicator charts below:

-   The black line is the trend for the hospital of interest
-   The grey lines are the trends for each control for the hospital of
    interest
-   The blue line is for the onset of COVID-19
-   The orange line is for the month where the hospital of interest
    introduced single bedrooms

::: panel-tabset

## HCAI

These are the charts for the contributed rate of Healthcare associated
Infections (HCAI) over time. For each of the bacteria below a rate of
the number of cases divided by the number of 10000 beddays was
calculated:

-   Clostridium difficile
-   Klebsiella
-   Ecoli
-   MSSA
-   MRSA
-   Pseudomonas Aeruginosa

The combined rate of HCAI was calculated as the sum of the above rates.

### Royal Liverpool

```{r}
tar_read(plot_hcai_royal_liverpool) |> 
  ggplotly()
```

## Overall Notes

-   COVID-19 has affected all measures
-   We do not have enough/any data pre SBR for some sites
-   Clatterbridge not in eric data before 2021
-   For turnover, should we look at joiners as well as leavers?
-   Friends and family and falls and fractures have NaN, probably
    because of zero denominators
-   Missing Readmissions
-   SBR available at provider only due to KH03 not being at site level
    for the denominator
